full_judgment: 9. Mr. Azizul Haque Shikder, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that the Court of appeal below having failed to appreciate that the deed in question was out and out sale and the same has been executed as deed of exchange in order to defeat the right of pre-emption of the petitioners. He further submits that the trial Court below on due consideration of the evidence on record rightly arrived at a finding that the vendor and vendee collusively created a deed of exchange in order to avoid pre-emption but the Court of appeal below without assigning any sound reason giving a go by to the consistent evidence of PWs. abruptly arrived at a finding that the pre-emptors having failed to prove that deed in question was a sale deed in the name of exchange and as such, the impugned judgment and order is not a proper judgment of reversal, which is liable to be set aside. Mr. Azizul Haque to fortify his submission has relied on a decision reported in 48 DLR 137.
